context:
Treat this as a contract-first workflow change. Document the release-required
guarantee, implement the minimal workflow jobs to enforce it for `main` PRs,
then add fast workflow-shape tests. Keep the ruleset update explicit because
GitHub rulesets are external state.
description:
Current release confidence depends on `main` PR rules that require lint plus
the fast `test` job. Non-fast suites are optional, scheduled, post-merge, or
manual. The release review concluded that this is not enough for a meaningful
release guarantee.

This TODO defines and wires the minimum mandatory release contract for
release branches accepted by `validate-main-pr.yml` targeting `main`. The
contract must be explicit, named, auditable from the repository, and suitable
for GitHub ruleset enforcement.

Target guarantee after completion:
  - Release PRs from branches matching the `validate-main-pr.yml` release
    regex cannot merge unless the fast test lane, the explicitly named
    integration-not-slow suite (`tests/integration -m "integration and not
    slow and not stress"`), dependency bounds, package build/install smoke,
    and release curation checks have passed on the PR branch.
  - The required check name is stable and documented for the
    `main-release-only` ruleset.
  - Optional/advisory lanes remain visible but are not confused with the
    release-required contract.

anti_patterns.dont: claim live ruleset enforcement unless the implementer verified or updated the live GitHub ruleset.
count push-to-main integration as pre-release evidence
require many unstable matrix job names in the ruleset if a single aggregator can preserve a stable context.
use the `run-integration` label as the release mechanism
anti_patterns.why: labels are manual discipline, not enforcement

deferrals.reason: Out of scope for the first mandatory release contract; handle with canary/ruleset drift TODO and explicit cloud-credential policy.
deferrals.summary: Make all live cloud and stress suites release-blocking

preserves.behavior: Develop PR path-aware `ci-required-result` behavior remains unchanged unless explicitly modified by a separate TODO.
GitHub Pages/docs workflows are not accidentally added to the release-required contract unless explicitly justified.
Post-publish `release.yml` still publishes from tags and still runs install smoke after publication.
Release branches remain the only allowed PR source for `main` as enforced by `validate-main-pr.yml`.

prior_art.concept: .github/workflows/pr.yml:ci-required-result — reuse aggregator pattern for a stable required check
.github/workflows/release.yml:test-installation — reuse post-publish smoke intent but move PR-time install smoke before publication
.github/workflows/test.yml:integration — extend existing integration job instead of adding duplicate integration commands
docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md:branch ruleset runbook — extend as the repository-visible ruleset source of truth

verifications.command:
uv run -- python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
for file in ['.github/workflows/test.yml', '.github/workflows/release.yml', '.github/workflows/validate-main-pr.yml']:
    yaml.safe_load(Path(file).read_text())
print('workflow yaml ok')
PY
for file in docs/operations/release-guide.md docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md .github/RELEASE_PR_TEMPLATE.md; do grep -q "release-required-result" "$file" || exit 1; done
verifications.description: Release docs mention the required check context
verifications.expected: release-required-result is present in every release operations surface

verifications.command: uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/todo_cli.py check-graph && uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/validate_todo.py _project/TODO/main/planning/release-required-main-pr-test-contract.yaml

work_units.notes:
Capture raw output under `/tmp/release-required-main-pr-w0/` and commit
only a compact summary in the PR body or TODO notes.

Required commands:
  - `git status --short --branch`
  - `grep -n \"name:\\|pull_request:\\|push:\\|integration:\\|test-package:\\|test (ubuntu\" .github/workflows/test.yml`
  - `grep -n \"ruleset\\|main-release-only\\|Required status\" docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md docs/operations/release-guide.md Makefile`
  - `uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/test_release_infrastructure.py -q`

Optional live verification, if the implementer has `gh` auth and the
user authorizes checking live admin state:
  - `gh api repos/joeharris76/BenchBox/rulesets --jq '.[] | {id, name, target}'`
  - Inspect the main ruleset required status contexts and record only the
    compact context list.

Decision gate:
  - If live ruleset state differs from the local runbook, update the
    runbook and PR body before changing required check names.
  - If live ruleset inspection is unavailable, proceed with repository
    workflow changes but leave ruleset update as an explicit manual
    action in the PR checklist.

Implementation evidence, 2026-05-25 on branch
`todo/release-required-main-pr-contract`:
  - `test.yml` still label-gated full integration with `run-integration`
    before this change.
  - Local runbook/docs still described `main-release-only` as lint/test
    based before this change.
  - Live ruleset inspection/update was not performed in this batch; the
    repository runbook now records the exact required contexts and a
    manual verification command.
work_units.summary: Re-validate current main PR workflow and documented ruleset assumptions

work_units.notes:
Update the maintainer release docs to name the exact pre-merge release
guarantee and the exact check context the main ruleset must require.

Required content:
  - What a successful release PR guarantees.
  - What it still does NOT guarantee (live cloud credentials, stress
    suites, long-running UAT unless separately invoked).
  - Required check context name, for example `release-required-result`.
  - Manual ruleset update steps if the check context changes.

Decision gate:
  - Do not edit `.github/workflows/test.yml` until the contract text
    exists. The workflow should implement the documented contract, not
    invent it.
work_units.summary: Define the release-required contract in docs before changing workflow logic

work_units.notes:
Change `.github/workflows/test.yml` so the `integration` job runs for
every PR targeting `main`, in addition to existing push-to-main behavior.
This workflow already only receives `pull_request` events for `main`, and
`validate-main-pr.yml` owns the exact release-branch regex. Do not add a
second approximate release-branch matcher here.

Candidate condition:
  `github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'main')`.

Decision gate:
  - If main PR volume makes running integration on every main PR too
    expensive, first extract a single reusable release-branch classifier
    from `validate-main-pr.yml`; do not use a broad `startsWith('v')`
    approximation.
work_units.summary: Force integration-not-slow to run on release PRs without relying on a label

work_units.notes:
Add an always-running aggregator in `.github/workflows/test.yml` for PRs
targeting `main`. It must fail unless all release-required jobs succeeded
or, for jobs intentionally out of scope, were skipped for a documented
reason.

Minimum required inputs:
  - `test (ubuntu-latest, 3.12)` fast job
  - release PR integration job from w2
  - package build/install job
  - dependency bounds / curation checks, either by reusing existing jobs
    or adding a small release-readiness job in the same workflow

Decision gate:
  - Do not make `release-required-result` depend on jobs from another
    workflow; GitHub Actions cannot express cross-workflow `needs`.
    Duplicate or move the release-readiness checks into this workflow if
    they must be aggregated.
  - Prefer one stable required context over requiring many individual job
    names in the GitHub ruleset. If individual contexts are selected
    instead, update `repo-admin-settings.md` with every exact context.
work_units.summary: Add a stable `release-required-result` aggregator job for main PRs

work_units.notes:
The current tag workflow publishes before cross-platform install smoke.
For PR-time release confidence, add or reuse a package smoke job that:
  - builds exactly one wheel from the PR branch,
  - installs it from a temp cwd with `uv run --isolated --no-project --with <wheel>`,
  - imports `benchbox` and runs `benchbox --help`,
  - does not use the project checkout as import fallback.

Decision gate:
  - Do not rely on post-publish `release.yml:test-installation` as a
    pre-release gate. It remains useful as post-publish verification but
    cannot block publication.
work_units.summary: Move pre-publish wheel install smoke before publication in the release contract

work_units.notes:
Add or update fast tests proving:
  - main PRs accepted by the `validate-main-pr.yml` release regex trigger
    integration without a label,
  - `release-required-result` aggregates the intended jobs,
  - release PR documentation names the same required context as the
    workflow,
  - `release.yml` still has no pytest and remains a publish workflow, not
    the pre-release correctness gate.
work_units.summary: Update tests that assert release workflow and ruleset contract shape

work_units.notes:
Update `docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md` so main ruleset state is
no longer opaque:
  - exact ruleset name,
  - required status contexts,
  - strict-base setting,
  - bypass actors,
  - verification command.

If the user authorizes live admin changes, update the ruleset to require
`release-required-result` and record the compact before/after context list.
If not authorized, leave a precise manual checklist and do not claim the
release gate is enforced live.
work_units.summary: Document and, if authorized, verify the main ruleset update
